definitions.explanation: One's existence from birth to death; the course of a person's life and experiences.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}は{一度|いちど}きりだ。
{人生|じんせい}で{一番|いちばん}{幸|しあわ}せな{日|ひ}だった。
examples.english: It was the happiest day of my life.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}の{人生|じんせい}を{送|おく}った。
examples.english: He lived a turbulent life full of ups and downs.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}の{中|なか}で{大切|たいせつ}なものは{何|なん}だと{思|おも}いますか。
examples.english: What do you think is important in life?

examples.japanese: {年|とし}を{取|と}ってから{人生|じんせい}を{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}ると、{若|わか}いころの{失敗|しっぱい}も{良|よ}い{経験|けいけん}だったと{思|おも}える。
examples.english: When you look back on life as you get older, even the failures of your youth seem like good experiences.

notes:
{人生|じんせい} refers to human life as a whole journey or experience.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {人生|じんせい}を{送|おく}る (to live one's life)
- {人生|じんせい}を{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (to look back on one's life)
- {人生|じんせい}{経験|けいけん} (life experience)
- {人生|じんせい}{設計|せっけい} (life planning)
- {人生|じんせい}の{先輩|せんぱい} (someone with more life experience)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人生|じんせい}: human life (philosophical, the journey of living)
- {生涯|しょうがい}: lifetime, one's whole life
- {生活|せいかつ}: daily life, living
- {命|いのち}/{生命|せいめい}: life (biological existence)
